metadata.summary: Fertigung Ost 27 is a procedurally generated two-storey factory building with about 5,394 m² across 79 spaces (56 rooms) and 505 assets. The ground floor holds production, assembly, additive manufacturing, warehouse and logistics zones, plus offices, meeting rooms, a quality lab, a server room, a kitchen, a locker room and a lobby. The first floor is mainly offices, with a server room, kitchens, meeting rooms and toilets. Machines include CNC mills, injection moulding machines, 3D printers, a waterjet cutter and forklifts. A lift and stairs connect both floors, and the building has step-free entrance access with full step-free coverage.
key_facts: Two floors (levels 0 and 1) with a total area of 5,394.45 m².
505 assets: 20 machines, 115 equipment items, 353 furniture items and 17 fixtures.

Machines: 3 CNC mills, 3 drill presses, 3 injection moulding machines, 2 industrial 3D printers, 2 3D printers, 2 forklifts, plus a conveyor, curing oven, waterjet cutter, compressor and coordinate measuring machine.
42 server racks, 51 pallet racks and 10 fire extinguishers.
Office lift (step-free) and office staircase (not step-free) both serve levels 0 and 1.
Step-free entrance with step-free coverage of 1.0; the ground floor has 4 entrances.
Source: procedurally generated for the Munich hackathon, CC0-1.0.

floors.name: Ground floor
floors.description: Ground floor (level 0, 8 m high, 4,556.85 m², 47 spaces, 27 rooms, 4 entrances). Hall space totals 2,525.7 m² and corridors 1,379.35 m². It includes warehouse (1,239.75 m²), production (495.9 m²), assembly, additive and logistics zones (247.95 m² each). It also has a lobby, offices, meeting rooms, a quality lab, a server room, a kitchen, toilets, a locker room, a stairwell and a lift. All 20 machines are here, along with 51 pallet racks and 23 server racks.

floors.name: Floor 1
floors.description: Floor 1 (level 1, elevation 3.5 m, 3.5 m high, 837.6 m², 32 spaces, 29 rooms, no entrances). An office floor with 411.85 m² of offices, kitchens (108.95 m²), a server room (65.2 m²), meeting rooms (61.85 m²), toilets, corridors, a stairwell and a lift. It has 32 desks, 19 server racks, 19 filing cabinets and 5 coffee machines.
